annotations.title: Scan Playlists After a Distributor Warning

description: Scores every Spotify playlist an artist pastes after a distributor flags a track for artificial streaming (the full list from Spotify for Artists). Use it for a batch of up to 50 links; for one playlist, use check_playlist, which also works anonymously. Returns each playlist ranked by bot-risk score with skip reasons for invalid or unavailable links. Free accounts get up to 2 scans a day with only the worst flagged playlist unlocked; Pro and Premium are unlimited with the full ranked report. Requires a signed-in account (anonymous callers are not supported). Supply artistName, trackName and distributor to also receive drafted reply text once the report is unlocked.

artistName.description: Artist name to fill into the drafted distributor reply and removal requests.

distributor.description: Distributor name, to address the drafted reply to.

links.description: Spotify playlist links, URIs or ids, one per line (also accepts comma or space separated), as pasted from Spotify for Artists. Up to 50.

trackName.description: The flagged track name, to fill into drafts.

name: scan_warning_playlists
